 AMI Arts Festival 2026 in Kolkata: Dates, Events, Venues and Highlights
 By IE Author - November 17, 2026 
 Source: ChatGPT 
 Kolkata is getting ready for a month of music, dance, theatre and art as the AMI Arts Festival 2026 begins on November 20. The festival will run until December 20, 2026, with events taking place across Kolkata and Santiniketan. 
 Organised by the Kolkata Centre for Creativity (KCC), the seventh edition will bring together more than 100 artists for over 70 events. Visitors can enjoy live music, theatre performances, art exhibitions, film screenings, workshops and more. The month-long festival offers something for everyone, from art lovers and music fans to people who simply want to explore Kolkata’s cultural scene. 
 What Is AMI Arts Festival 2026? 
 AMI Arts Festival is an annual cultural event organised by the Kolkata Centre for Creativity. The festival brings artists and audiences together through music, theatre, dance, exhibitions and other creative activities. The word “AMI” means “I” in Bengali. The festival takes inspiration from this word and focuses on how people express themselves through art. 
 This year’s event will feature both well-known performers and new artists. It also gives visitors a chance to discover different art forms, attend talks and take part in workshops. 
 AMI Arts Festival 2026 Dates and Venues 
 The AMI Arts Festival Kolkata will take place from November 20 to December 20, 2026. Events will happen at several popular cultural venues in Kolkata, along with programmes in Santiniketan. Here are the main festival details:

 Some of the main venues include Kolkata Centre for Creativity, Victoria Memorial Hall, Indian Museum, G. D. Birla Sabhagar, Gyan Manch and The Asiatic Society. Since events will take place at different locations, visitors should check the venue and timing before heading out. 
 Music and Theatre Highlights at AMI Arts Festival 2026 
 Music and theatre will be among the major attractions at this year’s festival. Visitors can enjoy Indian classical music, folk performances, jazz and modern music. The line-up includes popular artists such as Kaushiki Chakraborty, Parvathy Baul, George Brooks and The Raghu Dixit Project. 
 The Anirudh Varma Collective will also present Kahat Kabir, a musical programme inspired by the poetry of Kabir. The theatre programme will feature several plays, including Hamlet, Dance Like a Man and Kuch Panne. The performances will bring together actors, directors and theatre groups from different parts of India. With so many performances planned, visitors can choose shows that match their interests. 
 Art Exhibitions and Workshops to Explore 
 Art lovers will also have plenty to see at the Kolkata arts festival 2026. One of the main exhibitions, My Gaze: Aparna Sen, will feature photographs taken by filmmaker and actor Aparna Sen over the years. The exhibition will open at Kolkata Centre for Creativity on November 21. 
 Another exhibition, Jal, Jangal, Jamin, will showcase indigenous art, culture and traditional knowledge. Visitors can also explore Karigari, which will feature Indian crafts and handmade works by artisans from different parts of the country. Those who enjoy collecting art can visit the Collector’s Edit art fair. The festival will also have workshops where visitors can learn new skills and try different art activities. 
 Special Events at AMI Arts Festival 2026 
 Along with music, theatre and art exhibitions, the festival has several other events planned for visitors. One of the highlights is Evam Badal, a three-day event from December 4 to 6, 2026. It will mark 100 years since the birth of famous Indian playwright Badal Sircar. 
 Visitors can attend talks, watch performances and films, and join workshops to learn more about his work in Indian theatre. The festival will also have storytelling sessions, talks with artists and activities for young people. Some events will focus on making art easier to enjoy and take part in for people with disabilities. 
 How to Attend AMI Arts Festival 2026 in Kolkata 
 Thinking of visiting AMI Arts Festival 2026? The festival will have both free and paid events. You may be able to visit some exhibitions and activities for free. However, you will need tickets for certain shows and performances. Some workshops may also ask visitors to register in advance. 
 Before you go, check the event dates, timings, ticket prices and venue details on the official Kolkata Centre for Creativity website. 
 Why Should You Visit AMI Arts Festival 2026? 
 If you enjoy art, music or theatre, AMI Arts Festival gives you a chance to experience them in one place. You can watch live performances, explore exhibitions, meet artists and learn more about India’s different cultural traditions. 
 The festival also gives visitors a reason to explore some of Kolkata’s well-known cultural venues, including Victoria Memorial Hall and the Indian Museum. Whether you live in Kolkata or plan to visit the city, this month-long event could be an interesting addition to your plans. 
 AMI Arts Festival 2026 will bring a month of music, theatre, dance and art to Kolkata and Santiniketan. With more than 100 artists and over 70 events, the festival offers visitors plenty of ways to enjoy and explore different forms of creativity. 
 If you’re visiting Kolkata between November 20 and December 20, consider adding a festival event to your travel plans. Check the official schedule in advance so you don’t miss the performances or exhibitions that interest you.
